Subject: Rating synchronization snapshot + concrete next steps

Team —

Thanks for joining the calibration kickoff yesterday. Per our discussion I pulled a compact snapshot of the cross-team distributions and a short evidence packet for the outlier cases. Attached: cross-team_snapshot-2027-07-20.pdf and anchor_evidence_Q2.xlsx.

Objective for this thread: agree on the tie-break rules, rotate anchor reviewers for ambiguous cases, and land a short action grid with owners by EOD Friday. Specific asks below:

1) Review the 12 flagged profiles in the spreadsheet and indicate whether you: accept, escalate to org lead, or request additional evidence. Reply inline with the row numbers.
2) For any profile you pick up for adjudication, please add a 2–3 sentence rationale in the Evidence column. We will surface these to People Ops.
3) Decide whether we apply the tighter manager calibration (+0.25 adj cap) for ICs in Product vs. Engineering (vote yes/no).

Quick notes: we will avoid wholesale re-ranking; this is a synchronization pass to reduce cross-team variance ahead of comp planning. If you need a live slot to go over a contentious case, suggest a 30-min window and I’ll triage.

Thanks — L

--
Lauren Bishop
Director, Engineering Management
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Rating synchronization snapshot + concrete next steps

Thanks — skimmed the packet. I took rows 4, 7 and 9 for adjudication. Quick notes inline:
- Row 4: Accept (evidence: consistent peer feedback showing cross-functional impact; manager examples attached).
- Row 7: Escalate to org lead — manager has not documented objective outcomes; need sales/partner input.
- Row 9: Request additional evidence — last 90 days project metrics missing.

I also vote NO on the tighter manager calibration for Product ICs — we risk compressing valid differences.

If others can pick up row 2 and row 5 that helps balance load.

Marissa
VP, Customer Solutions

[attachment: manager_examples_row4.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Rating synchronization snapshot + concrete next steps

I reviewed the snapshot and left short rationale in anchor_evidence_Q2.xlsx for rows 1, 2, and 10. Summary:
- Row 1: Accept — corroborated by 3rd-party customer impact data; no change.
- Row 2: Request additional evidence — product telemetry missing high-fidelity metrics.
- Row 10: Escalate — manager has recommended promotion but calibration signals are misaligned.

I tentatively support the tighter manager calibration for Product (YES) because we saw compression risks in Q1 when managers were permissive. That said, if Product leaders supply objective success metrics in 48 hours, we can fold them back in.

Vivek
Head of Platform

Picking up rows 5 and 6. I put brief adjudication notes in the Evidence column of action_grid-v2.csv. Highlights:
- Row 5: Accept with note — has strong cross-team mentoring evidence; recommend inclusion in calibration summary.
- Row 6: Escalate to org lead — conflicting manager/peer signals, suggest a quick manager interview (15 min).

For the Product manager calibration cap: my vote is NO. We should reserve caps for orgs with systemic inflation; current distribution for Product looks two-tailed rather than uniformly inflated.

Also tagging @laura_bennett — please confirm People Ops bandwidth to intake escalations on Friday so we can be realistic about timelines.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Engineering Manager

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Summary / decisions: 

- Rows accepted: 1, 4, 5.
- Rows escalated: 6, 7, 10 — People Ops will intake these (per Laura) by 2027-07-28.
- Rows requesting evidence: 2, 9 — owners assigned: Vivek -> row 2, Marissa -> row 9. Evidence due 2027-07-23 EOD (extended to 2027-07-24 10:00 PT where people flagged constraints).
- Product manager calibration cap: Split decision. Vivek supports cap; Marissa and Karthik oppose. For fairness, we will NOT apply a global cap now. Instead we will pilot manager calibration guidance with two Product teams and reassess in 2 weeks.

Action grid (owners):
- Collate adjudication notes & finalize audit bundle: Marissa / Karthik (due 2027-07-24 12:00 PT)
- Submit escalations to People Ops: Laura (due 2027-07-28)
- Evidence collection for rows 2 & 9: Vivek / Marissa (due 2027-07-24 10:00 PT)
- Pilot manager guidance in two Product pods: Lauren / Product leads (start 2027-07-26)

If there are no objections I will forward the final bundle to compensation and close the loop next Monday. Thanks for the fast cadence on this.

Lauren
Director, Engineering Management
